evidence.quote: Radiographic confirmation of metastatic disease with at least 1 distant tumor metastasis measurable on radiology imaging per RECIST version 1.1 criteria
Must be a resident of Minnesota
Advanced stage (locally advanced or metastatic) pancreatic or colorectal cancer with no definitive plans for curative surgery in the next 3 months
At time of enrollment, the patient must have received 4-8 months of active chemotherapy with FOLFIRINOX or NALIRIFOX or gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel.
Locally advanced unresectable disease
Patients must have received at least one prior SOC regimen for advanced/metastatic pancreas cancer.
determination of FGFR gene fusions/translocations or activating mutations

evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed locally advanced, unresectable or metastatic cancer (Stage III or IV)

labels.note: Borderline resectable disease planned for neoadjuvant chemotherapy then surgery.

evidence.quote: Patients with suspected cystic neoplasm of the pancreas
Imaging showing possible pancreatic cancer
Histologically confirmed PDAC with successful (R0/R1) curative intent surgical resection
Clinically diagnosed pre-invasive pancreatic mucinous cystic neoplasm (MCN)
Participants whose tumor progressed on, or who were intolerant to standard therapy
pancreatic cancer with deleterious or suspected deleterious BRCA1/2 alteration
Relapsed or disease progression after having received 1 prior line of systemic therapy in the locally advanced/metastatic setting.

able to receive standard of care therapy that is therapeutic and not palliative
